entries.title: Initial release — full Title 7 coverage
entries.blurb: First complete snapshot of Government Code Title 7, Planning and Land Use: 1,076 sections across Division 1 (Planning and Zoning), Division 2 (Subdivisions), and Division 3 (Official Maps), mirrored from the official Legislative Information site. Legislative changes from this point forward are logged here automatically at each refresh. One recodification predating this snapshot worth knowing about: the accessory dwelling unit law formerly at § 65852.2 now lives at §§ 66310–66342.
